notes: Cash basis, governmental funds only (no business-type funds). Statement of Activities (p2) and governmental funds statement (p4) both roll fund balance / net position 17,577,116 to 19,545,940; beginning cash not printed (no prior-year cash figure), ending cash = Cash 19,545,940 (p3). Other taxes 1,545,100 split by fund name: Inheritance Tax Fund 856,640 (p18) is inheritance tax; the rest (Central Comm. 92,118 + Other Nonmajor Funds 596,342) stays other taxes. Intergovernmental kept as one statement line (includes COVID ARP federal 3,459,190). 'Local fees, licenses, commissions, and miscellaneous' kept as charges for services with review (Statement of Activities charges for services 6,113,731 + miscellaneous local 2,061,344 = 8,175,075). Detail: General Fund receipts and transfers from the budget schedule (p5-6); General Fund disbursements from the departmental Schedule of Disbursements (p13-17, more detailed; the function-level disbursement lines on p5-6 are not recorded to avoid double counting); Road and Bridge, COVID ARP, Detention and Capital Improvement budget schedules (p7-10); nonmajor funds per column from the combining schedule (p18), so the combined nonmajor budget schedule (p11-12) is not recorded. Lines with a budget but no actual are omitted. COVID ARP and Capital Improvement single lines have no printed section totals. Combining-schedule spending is by object only; functions taken from fund names with review, the 'Other Nonmajor Funds' column left as other. Veterans Service Officer is printed under the Public Works heading. Balance sheet from the governmental funds statement (equals the government-wide Statement of Net Position 19,545,940).
